description: Pre-loaded demos for the browser viewer. Real-project entries and the door family are MIT-licensed samples from magnetar-io/revit-test-datasets, staged from the _project_corpus/ checkout and hash-verified. Tiny reference models are this project's own MIT release assets (fixtures-tiny-1 and fixtures-tiny-2), staged from _tiny/ and hash-verified. Tier-1 entries are redistributable synthetic CFB fixtures from corpus/tier1/. Family RFAs from phi-ag/rvt stage when that corpus is present.
attribution: Real projects and the door family: magnetar-io/revit-test-datasets (MIT). Tiny reference models: this project's release assets (MIT). Synthetic samples and reference IFC fixtures: this project (Apache-2.0). Family RFAs: phi-ag/rvt sample licence, when staged.
license: Redistributable samples only; every staged file ships with a .license.json sidecar.

demos.name: Einhoven (Revit 2023, real project)
demos.description: Real Revit 2023 project from magnetar-io/revit-test-datasets (MIT). A curved curtain wall of 24 panels on its one Level, a wall and 2 windows, 26 of them drawn from the meshes Revit saved; glass panels are drawn see-through, as the glTF export writes a transparent material. This is the file the CI browser regression gates.
demos.shows: Curved curtain wall, see-through glass panels

demos.name: Core Interior (Revit 2024, real project)
demos.description: Real Revit 2024 project from magnetar-io/revit-test-datasets (MIT). 360 walls, 256 columns, 132 doors, 80 slabs, 116 rooms, 20 shading devices and 6 windows across 15 levels, with Revit's own ElementIds; doors and windows drawn from the meshes Revit saved. Its 18 floor plans, sections and elevations draw in the Drawings list. 32 MB download; decode takes a moment.
demos.expected_quality_note: Cross-witness gated element sets with bodies (tests/fixtures/project-counts/2024-core-interior.json).

demos.name: Door family in its sample wall (Revit 2020)
demos.description: Family file from magnetar-io/revit-test-datasets (MIT): a single flush door, its frame and leaf drawn from the family's own forms, shown in the sample host wall its template keeps, with the opening the family cuts through it, as Revit shows a door family in its own editor.
demos.expected_quality_note: Revit 2020 is read experimentally: 3 door parts and the sample wall.
demos.shows: Door family in its sample wall, opening cut

demos.name: RAC Basic Sample Family (2024)
demos.description: Family file: a table whose top and legs are drawn from the family's own extrusions, in their materials (Laminate - Ivory, Matte; Wood - Birch). Select the top or a leg to see its material's render appearance: the swatch Revit saved, the appearance schema and the bitmap files it names. Floor plan, ceiling plan, sections and elevations draw from the 3D model.
demos.expected_quality_note: The family's two forms are drawn from its own data; materials carry their render appearance (swatch, schema, bitmaps) in Element info.
demos.license: phi-ag/rvt sample redistributable (see the phi-ag/rvt LICENSE)
demos.shows: Family forms, materials, render appearance swatches

demos.name: RAC Basic Sample Family (2026)
demos.description: The same family saved by Revit 2026: the same forms, materials and appearances read from another release.
demos.expected_quality_note: The family's two forms are drawn from its own data; materials carry their render appearance (swatch, schema, bitmaps) in Element info.

demos.name: Stairs (Revit 2026, tiny reference model)
demos.description: A straight stair and a U stair with two runs and a landing, built in Revit 2026: 2 stairs, 3 flights drawn as their steps, the landing slab and 4 railings with their balusters. Built from scratch in Revit 2026 from its default template; its Revit API answer key ships beside it in the release asset.
demos.expected_quality_note: Answers known in advance: the release asset holds the Revit API's answer key for this file.

demos.shows: Flipped doors and windows, host wall

demos.name: Architectural 2024 (synthetic)
demos.description: Redistributable architectural synthetic: Level, Wall, Floor, Door, Window (5 each). Opens cleanly; expect scaffold ~25% export confidence — typed real-project extraction is unsolved.
demos.expected_quality_note: Scaffold ~25% is expected for tier1 synthetics. Useful for File status, confidence, and export buttons — not validated walls/doors/levels.
demos.shows: Synthetic: file status and scaffold export

demos.name: Synthetic IFC project fixture
demos.description: Hand-built IFC4 fixture — shows what the exporter produces without a Revit input. Not opened by the RVT parser; download/reference only.
demos.expected_quality_note: Reference IFC4 with typed elements from synthesized inputs. Viewer cannot parse IFC as input.

demos.name: Synthetic structural fixture
demos.description: Columns + beams + structural framing — exercises the IfcMember routing + RepresentationMap paths. Download/reference only.
demos.expected_quality_note: Reference IFC4 structural sample. Viewer cannot parse IFC as input.

schema_note: Frontend loader reads the staged catalog at /demos/catalog.json (written by viewer/scripts/stage-demos.mjs), copies redistributable binaries to /demos/, and renders a gallery with what each demo shows (`shows`), provenance and expected quality labels. The element_count_hint is a display value — the actual viewer runs its own element enumeration on load.
privacy_note: Every demo listed here has redistribution rights confirmed. Demo bytes are same-origin static assets fetched only when the user clicks a gallery entry (or during initial catalog load). Adding a new demo requires either (a) the contributor holds copyright and chooses to open-source it, or (b) the file is already under an open license allowing redistribution (e.g. phi-ag/rvt's MIT / sample-content clause). See docs/viewer-privacy-posture.md for the broader client-side-only posture.
